Title: Reverse DNS support for Azure Cloud Services

Body.Content: Azure Cloud Services supports reverse DNS records for all PaaS and IaaS Cloud Services. This support is backwards compatible with all existing Cloud Services, is supported in the Service Management API and PowerShell, and is being offered at no additional cost. For further details, please see this blog post.
